Specializing in difficult materials (stainless, titanium, molybdenum, carbide) and one-stop integrated manufacturing (CNC turning/milling, EDM, sheet metal, surface treatment) for semiconductor, medical, aerospace, automotive, and precision machinery clients.

About.story1: Weiyon Industry began as a small machining workshop in central Taiwan in the 1980s — when Taiwan's manufacturing sector was just taking off, and every process still relied on the senior machinist's hands-on judgment. Our origins reflect that era: starting with a drawing, a piece of stock, and a set of files.
About.story2: Over four decades, the industry transformed many times. CNC machines replaced conventional lathes; semiconductors, aerospace, and medical became new customer markets; materials expanded from stainless steel and aluminum to titanium and other difficult-to-machine alloys. We changed with it — from the nervousness of installing our first CNC mill to the confidence of running complex multi-axis paths today, every upgrade carried hours of relentless learning.
About.story3: But some things never changed. Daily machine checks before startup. A measurement record for every dimension. A batch number traceable on every piece of material. These seemingly old-fashioned disciplines are how we keep our promise on quality. When customers order, they receive more than parts — they receive 40 years of uncompromising commitment.
About.story4: Today's Weiyon Industry is built on the same conviction: get every part right. From one-off prototypes to volume production, from Taiwan-domestic to overseas orders, from traditional mechanical parts to advanced semiconductor components — no matter the size of the project, we treat every drawing as if it were our first.

Compliance.metaTitle: Compliance & Sustainability — GHG Disclosure & Supply-Chain Due Diligence
Compliance.metaDescription: Weiyon Industry's supply-chain compliance: voluntary GHG disclosure (Scope 1/2/3), global supply-chain due-diligence declaration, EN 10204 material traceability, 4-stage internal QC. Transparent documentation for global procurement.
Compliance.heroTitle: Transparent Data for Your Supply Chain
Compliance.heroSubtitle: EU CBAM (effective Jan 2026), national supply-chain due-diligence laws, and global procurement transparency requirements — this page publishes Weiyon's compliance information so buyers can complete supplier due diligence in one place.
Compliance.qualityTitle: Internal QC process and supply-chain documentation
Compliance.qcFlowDesc: Every order passes 4 documented quality gates from raw material to shipment: IQC incoming inspection → FAI first-article verification → IPQC in-process patrol → FQC final inspection. Each stage is documented and traceable.
Compliance.docsDesc: Material certificates, first-article reports, measurement records, batch traceability logs — issued per your buyer's audit standard. Common formats include EN 10204 3.1 / 3.2, AS9102 FAI, and PPAP (IATF 16949 system format).
Compliance.qualityNote: Industry-specific third-party certifications (IATF 16949 automotive, AS9100 aerospace, ISO 13485 medical, API 6A/6D oil & gas) — we operate as an OEM machining partner under our customers' certified supply chains rather than holding these directly; we deliver documents in the corresponding formats per your buyer's requirements.
Compliance.ghgSubtitle: This is Weiyon's voluntary GHG disclosure — not a legal mandate. We self-conduct an inventory under the GHG Protocol framework and publish estimates to help global buyers complete supplier due diligence. New annual data blocks will be appended each year; historical data remains for trend comparison.
Compliance.yearSubtitle2025: First voluntary GHG disclosure · Based on actual full-year 2025 operational data
Compliance.yearArchiveNote: Future annual data will be added as expandable sections, ensuring complete and comparable historical disclosure.
Compliance.perTonneNote: Scope 1+2+3 ÷ annual metal output — buyers can apply directly to product embedded-carbon estimates
Compliance.scope2Method: Monthly bill NT$ 25-35K (incl. air compressor) → ~120,000 kWh/yr × 0.495 kg/kWh
Compliance.scope3Source: Upstream materials (steel, aluminum, copper) + cutting oil & consumables
Compliance.scope3Method: Monthly material spend NT$ 180-240K → ~25 t metals/yr × 1.85 kg/kg; incl. cutting oil ~0.4 tCO₂e
Compliance.cbamFootnote: Methodology: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard (Scope 1/2/3 categorization, operational control boundary); spend-based + activity-based hybrid estimation. Sources: Taiwan Bureau of Energy (grid emission factor 0.495 kgCO₂e/kWh, published 2024); Worldsteel Association (steel emission factor ~1.85 kgCO₂e/kg); IPCC AR6 (gasoline EF 2.31 kgCO₂e/L). Boundary (included): direct fuels, purchased electricity (incl. air compressor), upstream key materials, cutting oil and production consumables. Boundary (excluded): employee commuting (GHG Cat 7, est. ~1 tCO₂e/yr — outside CBAM scope); facility rent (Cat 13, standard tenant practice excludes landlord-side); administrative services (accounting, banking — well below materiality threshold). CBAM form-filling service: full CBAM declarations can use product-specific tracked calculations. We provide the embedded-emissions data your EU importer needs for the declaration form — please indicate at quote time.
Compliance.lksgSubtitle: Aligned with the upstream due-diligence requirements of major frameworks: Germany LkSG, EU CSDDD, UK Modern Slavery Act, US Dodd-Frank Sec. 1502 conflict-minerals rule — covering labor, health & safety, environment, and anti-corruption. Provided to support your supplier qualification process.
Compliance.lksg1Desc: All employees employed under Taiwan Labor Standards Act — no forced labor, no child labor, freedom of assembly and association, statutory overtime pay. Standard 40-hour workweek.
Compliance.lksg2Desc: Factory operates under Taiwan OSHA Occupational Safety & Health Act. Personal protective equipment provided, regular equipment inspection, machine safety training. No major occupational accidents on record.
Compliance.lksg3Desc: Cutting fluids disposed via licensed contractors per Taiwan Waste Disposal Act. Metal chips recycled. No high-pollution processes in-house. Plating and surface treatment subcontracted to partners holding valid waste-treatment permits.
Compliance.lksg4Desc: Internal policies prohibit accepting bribes or undue benefits. Equal treatment of all customers; pricing based on cost + reasonable margin. IP respect — customer drawings strictly confidential.
Compliance.traceItem1Desc: Material certificates per EU EN 10204. 3.1 — standard mill certificate verified by independent inspector; 3.2 — higher-tier certificate accepted by a Notified Body. Issued per your buyer's procurement requirement.
Compliance.traceItem2Desc: First Article Inspection (commonly per AS9102 aerospace format) or Production Part Approval Process (IATF 16949 automotive-chain format) — complete pre-production documentation package, issued per customer procurement requirement.
Compliance.traceItem3Desc: From customer order → our batch number → raw material Mill Cert → process log → measurement records → shipping document, fully traceable. 3-year retention period.

Compliance.ctaSubtitle: CBAM, LkSG, PED, industry-specific certifications — tell us the specific documents your customer requires, we'll confirm whether we can support.

Privacy.dataCollectedBody:
(a) Information you provide (contact form):
• Required: name, email, message
• Optional: phone, company, country, quantity, INCOTERMS, attachments (CAD files, PDFs, etc.)

(b) Information collected automatically (only after cookie consent):
• Google Analytics 4: page views, events, geolocation (country/city level), device type, browser
• IP address: anonymized via GA4 anonymize_ip — last octet masked (e.g. 192.168.1.x → 192.168.1.0)
• Google Signals and Ad Personalization are disabled — your data is not used for advertising.
Privacy.legalBasisBody:
• Contact form data: legitimate interest in responding to your inquiry (Art. 6(1)(f)) and contractual necessity for fulfilling the inquiry (Art. 6(1)(b))
• Email notifications (sent to our inbox via Resend): same legitimate interest as above
• Google Analytics 4: based on your explicit consent given through the Cookie Preferences banner (Art. 6(1)(a)). You may withdraw consent any time (footer "Cookie settings").
Privacy.retentionBody:
• Contact form submissions: retained 3 years (matching our batch traceability retention) for inquiry follow-up and quality dispute resolution
• Attachment files (Supabase Storage): signed URLs valid 90 days, original files retained 3 years
• Google Analytics 4: GA4 default retention period of 14 months

After retention, data will be deleted or anonymized within a reasonable time.
Privacy.processorsBody:
To operate this site, we use the following processors qualified under GDPR Art. 28:

• Vercel Inc. (hosting) — USA, SCCs in place
• Supabase Inc. (database & file storage) — USA, SCCs in place
• Resend Inc. (email notifications) — USA, SCCs in place
• Google LLC (Analytics 4) — USA, certified under EU-US Data Privacy Framework

We have verified that these processors provide adequate data protection and process your data only on our instructions.
Privacy.transfersBody:
Because the above processors are located in the United States, your data may be transferred outside the EU/EEA.

We rely on the following mechanisms to ensure lawful transfer:
• Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs, 2021) — Vercel, Supabase, Resend
• EU-US Data Privacy Framework — Google LLC (certified)

You may request copies of relevant SCCs by contacting us.
Privacy.rightsBody:
You may exercise the following rights at any time:
• Right of access: obtain a copy of data we hold about you
• Right to rectification: correct inaccurate data
• Right to erasure (right to be forgotten): request deletion of your data
• Right to restrict processing: ask us to pause specific processing
• Right to data portability: receive your data in structured format
• Right to object: object to processing based on legitimate interest
• Right to withdraw consent: revoke GA4 cookie consent (footer "Cookie settings")
• Right to lodge a complaint: EU users may complain to their local data protection authority

How to exercise: email sales@weiyon.com — we will respond within 30 days.
Privacy.cookiesBody:
This site uses only two categories of cookies:

(a) Essential (no consent required):
• weiyon-cookie-consent (localStorage) — stores your cookie consent choice, 1-year retention
• Next.js / next-intl essential technical cookies (e.g. locale preference)
